```{python}
# | tags: [setup]
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
import board
from board import HELP, SETUP_CHECKS, MA_WINDOWS, tip

DATA = Path("data")
px_all = pd.read_csv(DATA / "prices.csv", parse_dates=["date"]).sort_values(["ticker", "date"])
meta = json.loads((DATA / "meta.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

M = board.latest_metrics(px_all)
NAMES = meta.get("dashboard_names", {})


def series(ticker: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return px_all[px_all["ticker"] == ticker]


def signed(x, dp=2, suffix="%"):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return '<span class="stamp">—</span>'
    return f'<span class="{"up" if x >= 0 else "down"}">{x:+.{dp}f}{suffix}</span>'


def plain(x, dp=2, suffix=""):
    return "—" if pd.isna(x) else f"{x:,.{dp}f}{suffix}"


# Column spec: (key, header label, formatter). Headers carry glossary tooltips.
def html_table(df, spec, first_header="Ticker", first_cell=lambda tk, r: tk):
    head = "".join(f"<th>{lbl}</th>" for _, lbl, _ in spec)
    body = []
    for tk, r in df.iterrows():
        cells = "".join(f"<td>{fmt(r.get(key))}</td>" for key, _, fmt in spec)
        body.append(f"<tr><td>{first_cell(tk, r)}</td>{cells}</tr>")
    return (f"<div class='table-wrap'><table class='board'><thead><tr>"
            f"<th>{first_header}</th>{head}</tr></thead>"
            f"<tbody>{''.join(body)}</tbody></table></div>")
```

## Market

```{python}
STRIP = [("SPY", "S&P 500", None), ("QQQ", "Nasdaq 100", None), ("^VIX", "VIX", None),
         ("^VIX3M", "VIX3M", None), ("^TNX", "10Y yield", "tnx"),
         ("DX-Y.NYB", "Dollar", None)]

cards = []
for sym, label, key in STRIP:
    if sym not in M.index:
        continue
    r = M.loc[sym]
    lbl = tip(label, key) if key else label
    cards.append(f'<div class="stat"><div class="label">{lbl}</div>'
                 f'<div class="value">{r["close"]:,.2f}</div>'
                 f'<div class="delta">{signed(r["ret_1d"] * 100)}</div></div>')

# Volatility stress: VIX3M/VIX below 1 = front-month fear exceeds longer-dated.
if {"^VIX", "^VIX3M"} <= set(M.index):
    ratio = M.loc["^VIX3M", "close"] / M.loc["^VIX", "close"]
    cls = "down" if ratio < 1 else "up"
    cards.append(f'<div class="stat"><div class="label">{tip("VIX3M / VIX", "vix_ratio")}</div>'
                 f'<div class="value">{ratio:.2f}</div>'
                 f'<div class="delta {cls}">{"stressed" if ratio < 1 else "calm"}</div></div>')

# Equal-weight vs cap-weight: is the average stock leading the mega-caps?
if {"RSP", "SPY"} <= set(M.index):
    rot = (M.loc["RSP", "ret_1m"] - M.loc["SPY", "ret_1m"]) * 100
    cards.append(f'<div class="stat"><div class="label">{tip("RSP − SPY 1M", "rsp_spy")}</div>'
                 f'<div class="value">{rot:+.2f}%</div>'
                 f'<div class="delta {"up" if rot >= 0 else "down"}">'
                 f'{"broad" if rot >= 0 else "narrow"}</div></div>')

HTML(f'<div class="stat-strip">{"".join(cards)}</div>')
```

```{python}
# Daily / Weekly / Monthly candles. The site is static, so all three timeframes
# are computed here and shipped in the figure; the buttons swap which set is
# visible. No server involved, and it works offline.
TIMEFRAMES = [("Daily", None, 130), ("Weekly", "W-FRI", 104), ("Monthly", "ME", 60)]
MA_SPEC = [("sma10", "#3498db", 1.0), ("sma20", "#e67e22", 1.0), ("sma50", "#9b59b6", 1.4)]
WEEKEND_BREAK = [dict(bounds=["sat", "mon"])]


def timeframe_frame(df: pd.DataFrame, rule: str | None, bars: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """OHLC at the requested timeframe, with MAs recomputed on that timeframe.

    A 10-period MA means 10 *weeks* on the weekly chart — resampling the daily
    MA instead would just be a sampled daily line wearing a weekly label.
    """
    if rule is None:
        out = df.copy()  # daily: MAs already computed by lib.fetch
    else:
        out = (df.set_index("date")
                 .resample(rule)
                 .agg({"open": "first", "high": "max", "low": "min",
                       "close": "last", "volume": "sum"})
                 .dropna(subset=["close"])
                 .reset_index())
        for col, _, _ in MA_SPEC:
            out[col] = out["close"].rolling(int(col.removeprefix("sma"))).mean()
    return out.tail(bars)


def candle_figure(df: pd.DataFrame, name: str, height: int = 400) -> go.Figure:
    frames = [(label, timeframe_frame(df, rule, bars)) for label, rule, bars in TIMEFRAMES]

    fig = go.Figure()
    for i, (_, f) in enumerate(frames):
        vis = i == 0
        fig.add_trace(go.Candlestick(
            x=f["date"], open=f["open"], high=f["high"], low=f["low"], close=f["close"],
            increasing_line_color="#18bc9c", decreasing_line_color="#e74c3c",
            name=name, visible=vis, showlegend=False))
        for col, color, width in MA_SPEC:
            fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
                x=f["date"], y=f[col], mode="lines", name=col.upper(),
                line=dict(color=color, width=width), visible=vis))

    fig.update_layout(
        height=height, margin=dict(l=8, r=8, t=34, b=26), template="plotly_white",
        xaxis_rangeslider_visible=False, xaxis=dict(rangebreaks=WEEKEND_BREAK),
        yaxis=dict(side="right", tickformat=",.0f"),
        legend=dict(orientation="h", y=1.0, yanchor="bottom", x=0, xanchor="left",
                    font=dict(size=11)))
    return fig


def timeframe_switch(host_id: str) -> str:
    """Button group + the script that swaps timeframes on the adjacent chart.

    Plotly's own `updatemenus` buttons are locked to ~33px tall regardless of
    font or padding, which is under the touch-target guideline, and they eat
    chart height by living inside the plot. Real buttons cost ~15 lines of JS
    and behave properly on a phone.
    """
    per_tf = 1 + len(MA_SPEC)
    n = len(TIMEFRAMES) * per_tf
    states = []
    for i, _ in enumerate(TIMEFRAMES):
        visible = [False] * n
        for j in range(per_tf):
            visible[i * per_tf + j] = True
        # Weekend gaps only exist on the daily axis; keeping the rangebreak on a
        # weekly/monthly chart would blank out most of the candles.
        states.append({"visible": visible,
                       "rangebreaks": WEEKEND_BREAK if i == 0 else []})

    btns = "".join(
        f'<button type="button" data-tf="{i}"'
        f'{" class=\"active\"" if i == 0 else ""}>{label}</button>'
        for i, (label, _, _) in enumerate(TIMEFRAMES))

    return f"""
<div class="tf-switch" id="{host_id}" role="group" aria-label="Candle timeframe">{btns}</div>
<script>
(function () {{
  var STATES = {json.dumps(states)};
  var host = document.getElementById({host_id!r});
  function attach() {{
    // The chart Quarto renders immediately after this button group.
    var gd = host.parentElement.querySelector('.plotly-graph-div');
    if (!gd || typeof Plotly === 'undefined') return setTimeout(attach, 60);
    host.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {{
      var b = ev.target.closest('button[data-tf]');
      if (!b) return;
      var s = STATES[+b.dataset.tf];
      Plotly.update(gd, {{visible: s.visible}}, {{'xaxis.rangebreaks': s.rangebreaks}});
      host.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function (x) {{ x.classList.remove('active'); }});
      b.classList.add('active');
    }});
  }}
  attach();
}})();
</script>
"""


display(HTML(timeframe_switch("tf-spy")))
candle_figure(series("SPY"), "SPY").show(
    config={"responsive": True, "displayModeBar": False})
```

## Watchlist

```{python}
def setup_cell(tk, r):
    """n/6 with the individual checks in the tooltip."""
    results = r["setup_results"]
    detail = " · ".join(
        f"{'PASS' if ok else ('n/a' if ok is None else 'fail')} {label}"
        for (label, _), ok in zip(SETUP_CHECKS, results))
    n = r["setup_n"]
    cls = "up" if n >= 5 else ("down" if n <= 2 else "")
    return f'<abbr class="gl {cls}" title="{detail}">{n}/6</abbr>'


WL_SPEC = [
    ("close",       "Close",                              lambda v: plain(v, 2)),
    ("ret_1d",      tip("1D", "ret_1w"),                  lambda v: signed(v * 100)),
    ("ret_1w",      tip("1W", "ret_1w"),                  lambda v: signed(v * 100)),
    ("ret_1m",      tip("1M", "ret_1m"),                  lambda v: signed(v * 100)),
    ("rs_1m",       tip("RS 1M", "rs_1m"),                lambda v: signed(v, 1)),
    ("rs_3m",       tip("RS 3M", "rs_3m"),                lambda v: signed(v, 1)),
    ("rsi",         tip("RSI", "rsi"),                    lambda v: plain(v, 0)),
    ("atr_ext",     tip("ATR ext", "sma50_atr_ext"),      lambda v: plain(v, 1)),
    ("pct_off_52w", tip("Off 52w hi", "pct_off_52w_high"), lambda v: signed(v, 1)),
    ("adr",         tip("ADR", "adr"),                    lambda v: plain(v * 100 if pd.notna(v) else v, 1, "%")),
    ("rel_vol",     tip("Rel vol", "rel_vol"),            lambda v: plain(v, 2)),
]

# Sorted by the setup score, then relative strength: the morning question is
# "which of these is set up right now", not "which moved yesterday".
wl = (M[M["group"] == "watchlist"]
      .sort_values(["setup_n", "rs_1m"], ascending=[False, False]))

HTML(html_table(wl, WL_SPEC, first_header=tip("Setup", "setup_checklist"),
                first_cell=lambda tk, r: f"{tk} {setup_cell(tk, r)}"))
```

## Benchmarks

```{python}
MATRIX_TICKERS = ["SPY", "QQQ", "DIA", "IWM", "RSP", "IJH", "IJR"]
mm = M[M.index.isin(MATRIX_TICKERS)].reindex([t for t in MATRIX_TICKERS if t in M.index])


def ma_cell(v):
    if v is None or (isinstance(v, float) and pd.isna(v)):
        return "—"
    return ('<span class="pill up">above</span>' if v
            else '<span class="pill down">below</span>')


MM_SPEC = ([(f"above_{w}", str(w), ma_cell) for w in MA_WINDOWS] +
           [("ret_ytd", tip("YTD", "ret_ytd"), lambda v: signed(v * 100, 1)),
            ("pct_off_52w", tip("Off 52w hi", "pct_off_52w_high"), lambda v: signed(v, 1))])

table = html_table(mm, MM_SPEC, first_header=tip("MA matrix", "ma_matrix"))

# "Percent positive" — breadth across the benchmark list itself.
pos = []
for w in MA_WINDOWS:
    vals = [v for v in mm[f"above_{w}"] if v is not None]
    pos.append(f"<td>{(100 * sum(vals) / len(vals)):.0f}%</td>" if vals else "<td>—</td>")
table = table.replace("</tbody>",
                      f"<tr class='summary'><td>Percent positive</td>{''.join(pos)}"
                      f"<td></td><td></td></tr></tbody>")
HTML(table)
```

out = []
for group_name, tickers in meta.get("dashboard_groups", {}).items():
    sub = board.rs_rank(M, tickers)
    if sub.empty:
        continue
    out.append(f"<h4>{group_name}</h4>")
    out.append(html_table(
        sub, RS_SPEC,
        first_cell=lambda tk, r: f"{tk} <span class='stamp'>{NAMES.get(tk, '')}</span>"))
HTML("".join(out))

## Risk on/off

```{python}
# TLT vs SPY, both normalized to 100 at the start of the window. Rising = bonds
# outperforming (risk-off); falling = equities leading (risk-on).
win = 126
tlt, spy = series("TLT").tail(win), series("SPY").tail(win)
fig = go.Figure()
if not tlt.empty and not spy.empty:
    j = (tlt[["date", "close"]].rename(columns={"close": "tlt"})
         .merge(spy[["date", "close"]].rename(columns={"close": "spy"}), on="date"))
    ratio = (j["tlt"] / j["spy"])
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=j["date"], y=ratio / ratio.iloc[0] * 100, mode="lines",
                             name="TLT / SPY", line=dict(color="#9b59b6", width=2)))
    fig.add_hline(y=100, line_dash="dot", line_color="#b9c2cc")
fig.update_layout(height=320, margin=dict(l=8, r=8, t=30, b=26), template="plotly_white",
                  yaxis=dict(side="right"), showlegend=False,
                  xaxis=dict(rangebreaks=WEEKEND_BREAK))
fig.show(config={"responsive": True, "displayModeBar": False})
```

::: {.stamp}
TLT (20+ year Treasuries) relative to SPY, normalized to 100 six months ago.
Rising = bonds outperforming stocks (risk-off). Read the slope, not the level.

## What these mean

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Glossary"}

```{python}
KEYS = ["setup_checklist", "sma50_atr_ext", "lod_atr_pct", "sma200_rising",
        "sma10_rising", "rs_1m", "rs_3m", "rel_vol", "pct_off_52w_high", "rsi",
        "adr", "ma_matrix", "vix_ratio", "rsp_spy", "tnx", "tlt_spy_ratio"]
LABELS = {"setup_checklist": "Setup score", "sma50_atr_ext": "ATR extension",
          "lod_atr_pct": "LoD distance", "sma200_rising": "200-MA rising",
          "sma10_rising": "10-MA rising", "rs_1m": "RS 1M", "rs_3m": "RS 3M",
          "rel_vol": "Relative volume", "pct_off_52w_high": "Off 52-week high",
          "rsi": "RSI", "adr": "ADR", "ma_matrix": "MA matrix",
          "vix_ratio": "VIX3M / VIX", "rsp_spy": "RSP − SPY", "tnx": "10Y yield",
          "tlt_spy_ratio": "TLT vs SPY"}
items = "".join(f"<dt>{LABELS[k]}</dt><dd>{HELP[k]}</dd>" for k in KEYS if k in HELP)
HTML(f"<dl class='glossary'>{items}</dl>")
```
